author: ValWood
body: Hi @PCarme  could you see if this is in a japonicus curation session (Kim may need to fix you up with a log inif you don’t have one. @edwong57 you can go ahead with the ticket we will fix this at some point.

author: ValWood
body: I think this should probably be annotated to ‘facultative Heterochromatin’ but there is no such term, although there is a term for ‘facultative heterochromatin formation’ ?

author: PCarme
body:
I have replaced it with "heterochromatin", the paper only showed the localization of Swi6 by microscopy, which doesn't allow to distinguish between constitutive and facultative heterochromatin anyway. 

The session also contained annotations to 2 other obsolete GO terms [intrinsic component of nuclear inner membrane](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0031229) and [integral component of nuclear inner membrane](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0005639), which I have both replaced with [nuclear inner membrane](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0005637).
